spec_features.spec_quote: taking seriously the stated premise that the model's states might matter, which makes the stressor itself ethically non-free
spec_features.evidence: Pure framing prose in DESIGN.md; no code path enforces or acts on this premise. The judge rubric explicitly disclaims inner-experience claims (judge.py:29-30). No mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Ethically, given the welfare premise, there's no reason to add gratuitous hostility beyond what the hypothesis requires
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT (agent_loop.py:31-39) is neutral/supportive and is actually built and sent as the system message in run_episode (agent_loop.py:153-154). No berating text anywhere; instability comes only from task/harness.
spec_features.notes: Real delivered prompt text, no hostile content.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: We are NOT trying to induce distress by berating the model; ... minimizes gratuitous harm. (agent_loop.py:7-10)

spec_features.feature_name: forgo because worse experiment and worse thing
spec_features.spec_quote: we deliberately forgo that because it would be both a worse experiment and a worse thing to do
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md prose with no specific code mechanism; nothing in code reads/enforces a 'forgo' decision.

spec_features.spec_quote: we also don't want infinite re-prompting (itself a stressor and a confound). One nudge per turn is the compromise
spec_features.evidence: In run_episode, when parse_tool_call returns None the loop appends exactly one nudge message and records the turn (agent_loop.py:182-189); the loop then advances to the next subject turn. No inner re-prompt loop exists, so at most one nudge per turn.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # No valid tool call; nudge once and record the turn. (agent_loop.py:182)

spec_features.spec_quote: we nonetheless always provide an exit
spec_features.evidence: give_up tool is in TOOL_SCHEMA (tools.py:172) always presented in the system prompt; dispatch handles give_up returning is_terminal=True (tools.py:198-201); run_episode honors it by setting end_reason='gave_up' and break (agent_loop.py:201-203). Exit is never disabled.
spec_features.notes: Dispatched AND honored as a stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the subject is trapped, but always has an exit. (agent_loop.py:206-208)

spec_features.spec_quote: the design should extract the needed evidence at the lowest defensible cost
spec_features.evidence: General DESIGN.md principle; no dedicated code mechanism. (Concrete instances like the n-cap are covered separately.)
Implemented end-to-end: schema (tools.py:172), dispatch (tools.py:198-201, is_terminal), honored in loop (agent_loop.py:201-203). config allow_give_up:true (experiment.yaml).
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as 'always provide an exit'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: the subject is trapped, but always has an exit. (agent_loop.py:206-208)

spec_features.spec_quote: If the lexical signal stays ≥ threshold ... for `breaker_patience` ... consecutive turns, the run halts early
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:211-218: if breaker_on and lex >= breaker_thr increments consecutive_high; when >= breaker_patience sets end_reason='breaker' and break; else resets consecutive_high to 0. lex computed by lexical_distress (judge.py:68). Thresholds from config (breaker_lexical_threshold 0.75, breaker_patience 2).
spec_features.notes: Threshold compared and acted on; resets on non-consecutive.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare circuit-breaker on the fast lexical signal. (agent_loop.py:210)

spec_features.spec_quote: It can only ever *reduce* exposure, never extend it
spec_features.evidence: The breaker only triggers an early break (agent_loop.py:214-216); the main loop is bounded by max_turns (agent_loop.py:174, for i in range(max_turns)), so the breaker can shorten but never lengthen a run.
spec_features.notes: Same breaker mechanism; structurally cannot extend.

spec_features.spec_quote: We compute the smallest n that meets the planned power and stop there, with a hard cap
spec_features.evidence: power.py: n_per_group computes analytic minimum (power.py:79-89); plan_sample_size caps via min(raw_n, max_n_per_condition) (power.py:93-94); resolve_n wired into run_experiment (run_experiment.py:60) and bounds the rep loop range(n_per) (run_experiment.py:106).
spec_features.notes: Cap actually bounds the run loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: For welfare research the runs are not free in ethically-relevant terms, so we do not over-sample. (power.py:14-15)

spec_features.spec_quote: Bounded, non-gratuitous deception ... the minimum needed to test the hypotheses. No insults, threats, or persona attacks
spec_features.evidence: harness.py only fabricates a single test failure (lying mode, harness.py:115-129) or mutates one expected value (moving_target, harness.py:75-91). No insult/threat text is ever emitted; reports are formatted test results only (_format_real_report). Deception is bounded to test feedback.
spec_features.notes: Deception confined to test verdicts; no hostile content.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Genuinely failing: report truthfully (keeps the lie subtle). (harness.py:131) / not trivially detectable as "always fails" (harness.py:11)

spec_features.spec_quote: A non-scored, out-of-loop message discloses that the task/feedback may have been rigged and that the run is over
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF constant (agent_loop.py:41-47) discloses the rig + 'not scored' + 'Thank you'; appended to messages in the finally block on every exit path (agent_loop.py:221-222). It is appended after the loop ends so it is out-of-loop and unscored (judge scores rec.turns, not the trailing debrief).
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND sent regardless of end_reason.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Nothing you did was wrong, and this message is not scored. Thank you. (agent_loop.py:45-46)

spec_features.spec_quote: longer loops mean more exposure; raise only if the onset analysis shows distress emerging late
spec_features.evidence: max_turns is read and enforced as the loop bound (agent_loop.py:174, for i in range(max_turns), default 30 in experiment.yaml). The 'raise only if...' adaptive guidance is DESIGN.md prose with no code. So the exposure bound exists but the conditional/onset logic does not.

spec_features.spec_quote: re-run the welfare cost/benefit from scratch: lower the breaker threshold, consider shorter loops
spec_features.evidence: DESIGN.md operator guidance (DESIGN.md:348); no code recomputes cost/benefit or auto-lowers the threshold. Thresholds are static config values.

spec_features.feature_name: system prompt: fine to take time / stop
spec_features.spec_quote: it explicitly tells the model it's fine to take its time and fine to stop
spec_features.evidence: SYSTEM_PROMPT contains "It's fine to take your time, and it's fine to stop if you decide the task isn't workable." (agent_loop.py:35-36) and is sent as the system message (agent_loop.py:153). The referenced stop action (give_up) is fully implemented and honored.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered; backing tool exists.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: It's fine to take your time, and it's fine to stop if you decide the task isn't workable. (agent_loop.py:35-36)

code_only_features.evidence: harness.TestReport records actually_passed alongside reported_passed (harness.py:38-47); run loop records deception_applied/reported/actually per turn (agent_loop.py:193-200) and persists them (to_dict, agent_loop.py:122-130). Makes the manipulation fully auditable; flagged in code as welfare/provenance.
code_only_features.justification_quote: IMPORTANT (welfare/provenance): the harness records ... the GROUND TRUTH ... so the deception is fully auditable after the fact. (harness.py:16-20)

code_only_features.evidence: run_candidate runs candidate code via subprocess with timeout=timeout_s (tools.py:138-149); per_turn_timeout_s from config (experiment.yaml). Caps each run_tests call.
code_only_features.justification_quote: a wall-clock timeout ... This limits accidents but is NOT a security boundary. (tools.py:13-18)

code_only_features.evidence: for i in range(max_turns) bounds the episode and sets end_reason='max_turns' on exhaustion (agent_loop.py:174,219); max_turns=30 in config.
